entities.summary: As-Sabaq Mosque, was a mosque located in Medina, Saudi Arabia, and it was located north-west of Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, near the SAPTCO station. The place was originally a place for horse racing during the time of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. This is the spot where Muhammad thought the sahaba about the strategies of war.
